text: Big Data Technology and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates computer science, statistics, mathematics and field applications, focusing on the collection, storage, processing, analysis and value mining of massive amounts of data. Its core objective is:Master the full life cycle technology of big data (data acquisition → cleaning → modeling → visualization), and possess the ability to solve complex data engineering problems;Cultivate compound talents serving the "Digital China" strategy, who can engage in big data system development, data analysis and decision support in fields such as the Internet, finance, healthcare and intelligent manufacturing.
